overview: You entered a silver thimble at two shillings and sixpence. You wrote no name on the line and no day on the paper. You wrote no total. You did not open the chest.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the one line, and did not open the chest.

important_dates.meaning: Two shillings and sixpence, and no name

summary: Entered a silver thimble at two shillings and sixpence
